Name: JojaBox - Subscription Box
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=4][b]Welcome to JojaBox, the subscription box tailored to YOU! [/b][/size][size=3]

This mod adds JojaBox, a mail-based subscription box with random items. The first time you play, you'll receive a welcome letter with information about the JojaBox service. Each Sunday (with a weekly subscription) or on the 28th (with a monthly subscription), you'll receive a letter [size=3]containing the amount of tickets corresponding with your subscription level[/size]! The fee will be automatically taken from your funds.

These tickets can be used with a JojaBox Materializer (purchasable from JojaMart for 3,000g) to create a random item from the category you are subscribed to. You might receive an item worth far less than the cost of a ticket... but you might also receive a rare treasure! Such is the joy of JojaBox.

Subscription categories include:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]Home Chef [/b](FruitVeg): This subscription costs 250g per ticket and creates fruit & vegetables.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Good Eats [/b](Food): This subscription costs 300g per ticket and creates food items.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Farmer's Delight [/b](Seeds): This subscription costs 80g per ticket and creates crop seeds.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Geo Collector [/b](GemsMinerals): This subscription costs 80g per ticket and creates gems and minerals.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Green Thumb [/b](Fertilizer): This subscription costs 250g per ticket and creates fertilizers.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Ancient Treasures [/b](Artifacts): This subscription costs 200g per ticket and creates artifacts.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
Other subscription options include:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]Weekly or Monthly Subscription[/b]: Select whether you will receive tickets every Sunday or only on the last day of the season.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Subscription Tier[/b]: Your subscription tier indicates how many tickets you would like to receive, with options available for 1, 3, 5, or 10 tickets.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
If you don't have enough money to cover your subscription fees, you won't go into debt but also will not receive any tickets for that week/month. You do not need to have bought a Joja membership in order to use this mod.

[/size][size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Content Patcher[/size]
[*][size=3]Producer Framework Mod[/size]
[*][size=3]JSON Assets[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Installation:[/size][/b][size=3]
To install, simply extract the "Joja Subscription Box" folder and drop it into your Mods folder. Do not remove any of the three folders inside, as all three are needed for this mod to work.

[b][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/b][size=3]
JojaBox is compatible with mods that add new items in the subscription categories and these will automatically be added as potential items that can be created by the Materializer.[/size] It will exclude any items marked 'exclude from random sale' or with a sell cost of less than 1g.

The materialiser also will not spawn any items with the "jojabox_blocked" context tag. If your mod has custom items that you'd prefer not to be available via JojaBox, you can add that context tag to them and they'll automatically be blocked.

[b]NOTES:[/b]
To configure this mod, use GMCM. Talking to Morris will not allow you to change your subscription.

If you have already finished the Community Centre and JojaMart is no longer in town, you will not be able to buy a JojaBox Materializer. Set the "[b]SendJojaBoxMaterializer[/b]" option to "true" to receive a one-off letter with a JojaBox Materializer for 7000g.


[size=3]The Portuguese translation was created by Kanadeyoru.[/size]
[/size]
